sites.summary: Girls' boarding school founded by Mary Ann Aldersey, the first Protestant woman missionary to China, in a wooden house by the river outside the city. Exact location needs geocoding.
sites.summary_zh: 由来华第一位基督教新教女传教士阿德希创办的女子寄宿学校，最初设在城外河边的一座木屋。具体位置尚待确定。

events.description: Maria Dyer came to teach here with her sister; she met Hudson Taylor in Ningbo.
events.description_zh: 玛丽亚随姐姐来校任教，并在宁波与戴德生相识。

events.description: Transferred to the American Presbyterian mission and renamed Chongde Girls' School.
events.description_zh: 移交美国长老会，改名崇德女校。

sites.modern_address: Inside the North Gate, Ningbo (historic site)
sites.summary: Rooms rented at the Yousheng Temple inside Ningbo's North Gate, where Divie Bethune McCartee opened a clinic and helped start the Presbyterian mission station. Exact location needs geocoding.
sites.summary_zh: 麦嘉缔在宁波北门内佑圣观租房开设诊所，并参与创建长老会宣教站。具体位置尚待确定。

sites.summary: China Inland Mission church in Wenzhou built under George Stott; burned in 1884 and rebuilt the next year. Exact location needs geocoding.
sites.summary_zh: 曹雅直主持修建的中国内地会温州教堂，1884年被焚，次年重建。具体位置尚待确定。

sites.name_en: Ren'ai Free School (later Chongzhen Primary School)
sites.summary: Boys' school started by George Stott. Exact location needs geocoding.
sites.summary_zh: 曹雅直创办的男子学塾。具体位置尚待确定。

sites.summary: Girls' school begun by the Stotts' mission in Wenzhou. Exact location needs geocoding.
sites.summary_zh: 曹雅直夫妇在温州开办的女子学校。具体位置尚待确定。

sites.summary: Church established in Wenzhou by George Stott together with Cai Wencai. Exact location needs geocoding.
sites.summary_zh: 曹雅直与蔡文才在温州建立的教会。具体位置尚待确定。

events.description: Established by George Stott with Cai Wencai.
events.description_zh: 曹雅直与蔡文才共同建立。

sites.summary: Methodist Missionary Society (British) hospital in Wenzhou. Exact location needs geocoding.
sites.summary_zh: 英国循道会（卫斯理会）在温州开办的医院。具体位置尚待确定。

events.description: Founded by the Methodist Missionary Society (British).

sites.current_status: The First Hospital of Jiaxing (moved to a new site in 2011)
sites.current_status_zh: 今嘉兴市第一医院（2011年迁至新址）
sites.summary: Catholic church hospital founded by the French Catholic mission; merged into the Jiaxing Municipal Hospital in 1952. Exact location needs geocoding.
sites.summary_zh: 法国天主教会创办的教会医院，1952年并入嘉兴市立医院。具体位置尚待确定。

events.description: Founded by the French Catholic church.
Merged with the Jiaxing Medical Institute as the Jiaxing Municipal Hospital.
events.description_zh: 与嘉兴医学院合并为嘉兴市立医院。

sites.modern_address: Yangliu Street, North Gate, Jiaxing (historic address)
sites.summary: Southern Presbyterian hospital on Yangliu Street by Jiaxing's North Gate. Exact location needs geocoding.
sites.summary_zh: 美南长老会在嘉兴北门杨柳街开办的医院。具体位置尚待确定。

events.description: Founded around 1900 by the Presbyterian Church in the U.S. (South).
events.description_zh: 约1900年由美南长老会创办。

sites.summary: Hospital at Huzhou's South Gate sponsored by the Methodist Episcopal Church, South; run as a union hospital from 1918 to 1927. Exact location needs geocoding.
sites.summary_zh: 位于湖州南门、由美国监理会资助的医院，1918至1927年为联合医院。具体位置尚待确定。

events.description: Founded (1911 according to a 1932 medical directory).
events.description_zh: 创办（1932年《医界指南》记为1911年）。

events.description: Operated as a union hospital until the union dissolved in 1927.
events.description_zh: 改为联合医院，1927年联合解散。
